event.description: Tie the final LayerNorm to the shared feed-forward pre-normalization while retaining corresponding LayerNorm sharing across blocks, reversed operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, ff=19, rank-3 learned positions, and the 45000-step schedule.
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Retained incumbent is 3073 parameters at 99.710000%, a +0.710000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0038, corresponding LayerNorm sharing across blocks (3073, 99.71%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0037, Q/K sharing, an optimization failure with 11.4% peak validation; 5 prior parameter-tying candidate attempts. The preceding rank-2 reversed-input attempt-0036 is an optimization failure (45000 steps, 11.1% peak validation, no checkpoint), not a scored nonqualification. Hypothesis: the final output normalization may use the same learned affine calibration as the feed-forward pre-normalization now already shared across depth; this removes just one 14-scale-plus-14-offset vector, reducing actual parameters from 3073 to 3045. This is a parameter-tying change, not scalar pruning. It is more informative than removing that final affine entirely because it distinguishes redundancy through reuse from the need for normalization itself.
